image_description: Two large blue plastic industrial drums (55-gallon style) positioned side-by-side on a wooden pallet outdoors. The left drum has white labels and a green hose connected near the bottom. The right drum is plain blue with a similar hose connection. A chain-link fence and vegetation are visible in the background.

The context of hoses and outdoor placement strongly implies use as a water collection vessel.
